title: A unique compatible leg on one local pointed etale triple
statement: Let R be a commutative ring, p a prime, K a field and χ:κ_R(p) → K a field map [def-weil-residue-field]. Put A=R_p [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]. Let q in Spec A and ψ:κ_A(q) → K have evaluation equal to a specified A-algebra map, whose restriction to R is evaluation through χ. Given a ring V and a cocone η on the ring diagram of global pointed etale triples [def-weil-pbc-etale-residue-triples], for each single local pointed etale triple t there is exactly one ring map b:t.B → V such that β followed by b equals η_s for every global triple s and every ring map β:s.B → t.B commuting with the R-structure and the pointings to K. This statement concerns one component, not a natural transformation on the local category.

source.place: Tags 00CR, 01ZM, 07RP, 01Z6 and 04GW; localization and affine finite-presentation descent argument

proof.text: Apply localization_colimit_principalLocalizations to the complement of p. Take Spec to obtain the directed inverse system of affine principal neighborhoods with limit Spec R_p.

Apply etale_finite_data_descent to Spec t.B. Its etale affine structure map is finitely presented. The resulting model and all later base changes are qcqs with affine transitions, and their limit is Spec t.B. Apply the affine-limit lemma to this upper-tail model system, so some later model is affine. Write it as Spec C; base change identifies t.B with the localization of C at the images of R outside p.

The model C is etale over R_s and R_s is etale over R; composition gives an etale R-algebra. Its pointing is the restriction of t.B to K. The kernel is prime; the injection C/kernel into K extends uniquely to its fraction field. The identities hψ and hK show that the prime lies over p and the residue embedding is compatible with χ. This gives a global triple c and a pointed map C to t.B.

For r outside p, its image in C lies outside the kernel of the pointing, because the base evaluation through χ has kernel p. The unit-refinement theorem supplies a global arrow c to c_r sending that image to a unit. Apply global cocone naturality: η_c is η_{c_r} composed with that arrow, so it sends the image of r to a unit. The localization universal property now gives a ring map b:t.B to V extending η_c.

Given any global triple s and a pointed R-map β:s.B to t.B, pass to the chosen principal stage and apply morphism descent to the base change of Spec s.B and the affine model of Spec t.B. At a later common principal stage β is represented by a ring map from a principal refinement of s.B into a principal refinement of C. Give both refinements their restricted pointings into K; equality with β after localization makes this arrow pointed. Naturality of η for the refinement arrows and the descended arrow shows β followed by b equals η_s. The extension b restricts to the model leg at every refinement because localization extensions are unique.
Any other compatible ring map restricts on the chosen pointed model C to η_c. Since t.B is a localization of C, localization extensionality makes it equal to b.

proof_origin.place: The localization and descent argument of the parent, specialized to a single local object; affine model supplied by 01Z6

theorem etaleResidueTriples_primeLocalization_component_extension
    (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (p : Spec R) (K : Type u) [Field K]
    (χ : (Spec R).residueField p ⟶ CommRingCat.of K)
    (q : Spec (CommRingCat.of (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)))
    (ψ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal))).residueField q ⟶
      CommRingCat.of K)
    [Algebra (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal) K]
    (hψ : (ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal))).inv ≫
      (Spec (CommRingCat.of (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal))).Γevaluation q ≫ ψ =
        CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal) K))
    (hK : CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)) ≫
      CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal) K) =
        (ΓSpecIso R).inv ≫ (Spec R).Γevaluation p ≫ χ)
    (V : CommRingCat.{u})
    (η : etaleResidueTriplesRingDiagram R p K χ ⟶ (Functor.const _).obj V)
    (t : EtaleResidueTriples (CommRingCat.of (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)) q K ψ) :
    ∃! b : t.B ⟶ V,
      ∀ (s : EtaleResidueTriples R p K χ) (β : s.B ⟶ t.B),
        s.α ≫ β = CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)) ≫
          t.α →
        β ≫ (ΓSpecIso t.B).inv ≫ (Spec t.B).Γevaluation t.q ≫ t.φ =
          (ΓSpecIso s.B).inv ≫ (Spec s.B).Γevaluation s.q ≫ s.φ →
        β ≫ b = η.app s
